CommunityApplications.Profile: **Unraid Secretary Office** — a staff of secretaries inside Unraid's web UI, each looking after one part of your server: backups (Mr. Backupsy), restores (Mr. Restori), snapshots (Ms. Snapshotini), logs (Ms. Protocolli), security watch (the Night Watchman), what lies where and tidying up (Ms. Dustdevil), Emby caching (Jack Emby), the tools it relies on (the Consultant) and the Team Lead who tells you what is left to do. Support and issues on GitHub (a forum thread follows).
